collegeFullAddress: Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management, IIT Bombay, Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400076
collegeInfo: The Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management (SJMSOM) at IIT Bombay is one of India's premier business schools. Established in 1995, the school is renowned for its strong academic rigor, deep industry connect, and cross-functional opportunities afforded by being part of IIT Bombay. SJMSOM offers a two-year MBA program and is consistently ranked among the country's top 10 management institutes.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Students from economically weaker backgrounds with a required minimum academic performance.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply through IIT Bombay student portal after admission.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Open for SC/ST students as per Gov. of India norms.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Automatic or application through student portal.

events.eventFullDescription: Avenues is SJMSOM's flagship business school festival with a diverse range of management, entrepreneurial, and cultural events. It attracts students and corporates from across India, hosting competitions, workshops, panel discussions, and leadership talks.

Continuum is a rolling seminar series focused on key management domains – Marketing, Finance, Operations, Systems, Consulting, and Analytics. Esteemed speakers and alumni from industry deliver talks and workshops through the year.

infrastructure.infraDescription:
SJMSOM is located within IIT Bombay's scenic and sprawling Powai campus. The school features modern classrooms, a state-of-the-art learning resource center, finance and analytics labs, and incubation facilities. Students benefit from unparalleled IIT-wide resources—including hostels, sports complexes, and cultural centers.

Academic Infrastructure🏫

  • Smart Classrooms: Equipped with advanced AV and digital learning aids.

  • Library: Access to IIT Bombay Central Library with 500,000+ books/journals and online resources.

Residential Facilities🏨

  • Hostel: On-campus hostels with single/double occupancy rooms, mess, gym, and recreation facilities.

Recreation & Amenities☕

  • Sports & Gym: Extensive grounds and dedicated facilities for indoor and outdoor sports.

  • Cafeteria: Multiple student canteens and food joints on campus.
